India launched three AI models of its own: Eka-1, Dhir-2B and Dhir-5B.

MeitY Secretary S. Krishnan launched them in New Delhi on 3 November 2026. The focus is education and research, including Indian languages.

Their real impact depends on performance and adoption. We will test them when we can.

Source: Entrepreneur India.
